Guide

Development roadmap

Create → build → configure → integrate → edit world → run → reject/regress → continue.

The order refines the suggested roadmap: minimal item/reward schemas precede08 rewards, and minimal party credit contracts precede18 dungeon content even though full party UX arrives19. Definition identities are early; complete UI/content is staged.

PhasePurposeTest worldStop condition
00 · Sources, tools and test bootstrapPin engine/toolchain/plugin evidence; establish paths, IDs, documentation and dedicated-server build prerequisites.L_TerrainLabInstallation record, source provenance, plugin gate and a blank C++ project created by the developer.
01 · Sprite, camera and layering labProve a common body on 3D ground with four facings, zoom, depth, feet and a clothing fallback.L_ArtLabLocal capsule and layered sprite remain aligned through four facings; art source gap stays explicit.
02 · Three-dimensional locomotionUse CharacterMovement across X/Y with Z height; add jump, sprint, dodge, swim and fall/shoreline rules.L_TerrainLabOne movement integrator; no X/Z plane constraint or sprite-collision authority.
03 · Dedicated server and two clientsConnect independent clients, possess once, replicate movement and remote appearance intent.L_NetworkLabTwo remote clients with server authority; connection loss cleans up input and references.
04 · Accounts and character creationUse a development authenticator boundary; create/list/select a named class/body/appearance record.L_FrontEndCreation is server/backend validated; previews never become persistent authority.
05 · Durable character serviceCreate the versioned schema, command receipts, session fencing and minimal reward/item identities.L_NetworkLabOne character lease; retry after a lost acknowledgement returns the existing receipt.
06 · Two-zone handoffAuthor two zone catalogs/gates, allocate two servers and transfer only one player.L_RillmereClientTravel changes that client only; stale source writes and duplicate tickets reject.
07 · GAS and authoritative combatInitialize PlayerState/enemy ASCs; prove costs, cooldowns, target checks, melee and projectiles.L_NetworkLabAccepted attacks apply once without animation notifies and correct predicted UI on rejection.
08 · AI, defeat credit, XP and recoveryBuild server AI and defeat ledger, minimal party eligibility, XP awards and safe respawn.L_RillmereSlice A: two players fight and receive recorded XP; death and reconnect do not repeat rewards.
09 · Items, bags and equipmentCreate real inventory UI/stack rules, item requirements and replicated logical/visual equipment.L_RillmereCapacity/conflict errors do not partially move gear; missing clothing keeps item stats.
10 · Weighted loot and ownershipMaterialize loot once for a defeated spawn generation; expose corpse/container interaction.L_RillmereGuaranteed and random allocations remain unchanged after reload and replay.
11 · Merchants, currency and bankCommit buy/sell/buyback/repair and deposits/withdrawals through authenticated service commands.L_RillmereConcurrent last-stock/slot/currency operations have one coherent result.
12 · Randomized mining and woodcuttingSelect eligible sites per zone seed; validate tools, action leases, yield, XP and respawn.L_RillmereTwo players contest the same node and exactly one depleted-generation grant succeeds.
13 · Crafting professionsLearn recipes, use stations and consume materials/currency atomically for deterministic items.L_RillmereDisconnect after confirm and reconnect in another zone preserves exactly one crafted result.
14 · FishingValidate shoreline casts, world bobber, bite window, reel and terminal fish reward.L_RillmereOne fishing attempt has one terminal outcome; replay/notify/restart cannot add catches.
15 · Village dialogue and quest loopAuthor conditional NPC dialogue and a quest DAG using server gameplay events and receipt-backed rewards.L_RillmereSlice B includes quest/fight/loot/gather/fish/craft/shop/equip/death/reconnect.
16 · Four-class talents and progressionBuild all four ability catalogs, validated skill graph, derived stats and paid respec.L_RillmereExclusive branches and prerequisites hold; respec cannot strand required progression.
17 · Exploration and world productionAdd discovery/minimap, time/weather, six region plans and a data-driven content factory.L_MorrowfenNew zones register without native rule changes; weather/discovery survive transfer policies.
18 · Elites, bosses and dungeonsAdd phases/telegraphs, four-player instanced ruin allocation and recovery/loot rules.L_SluiceVaultParty reservation is atomic; boss defeat/reset/instance retry grants only intended rewards.
19 · Social and secure tradeExtend minimal parties into invites/chat/friends/block/private messages and escrow trades.L_RillmereBlocking and moderation affect delivery; both trade acceptances bind one offer revision.
20 · Reputation, trainers and hubsAdd faction thresholds, profession/class training, safe-hub unlocks and world event participation.L_KestrelCrownServer-recorded reputation and paid travel/training are validated and durable.
21 · Guilds and committed growthAdd guild roles/invites, social dashboards, content expansion; mounts stay behind an art/movement gate.L_VarranHallsGuild mutations are authorized and versioned; no unverified mounted art is enabled.
22 · Operations, security and measured scaleExercise restarts, restores, fencing, dupe attacks, deployment and replication comparisons.L_LoadTestPublish measured budgets and incident runbooks; do not substitute actor counts for real load tests.
23 · Packaged release-candidate proofRun complete packaged client/server slices, localization/accessibility and documentation consistency.L_RillmereSlice C requires retained test evidence, recovery proof and no unresolved critical economy failures.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
